# T-2: Enforce completion policy

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Route target step completion through the shared policy so normal, override, and inconsistent outcomes are decided by the same validator.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `flow set step <id> done` refuses inconsistent target-step completion without changing step status.
- Registry post hooks mark target steps done only when the shared validator permits normal or override completion.
- Unit tests cover R2, R4, and R5 for all target steps.

## Implementation Notes
Update `src/flow/lib/set-step.js` and `src/flow/registry.js` to use the common validator instead of duplicating verdict checks.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests under `specs/271-flow-judgment-contract/tests/` include `// spec: R2 R4 R5 ...` headers and use flow fixtures for target steps, asserting status persistence only on validator-approved outcomes.
